en.headline: Private residential price index rises 0.3 per cent in June
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department reported the index at 323.2, up 12.7 per cent year on year and nearly 8 per cent for the first half.
body: The Rating and Valuation Department said Hong Kong’s private residential price index stood at 323.2 in June, rising about 0.3 per cent from May. The year-on-year increase was 12.7 per cent.
For the first half of 2026 the index accumulated a gain of nearly 7.9 per cent. The monthly rise slowed compared with earlier months in the year.

Small and medium-sized units (under 100 square metres) also rose about 0.3 per cent month on month and 12.9 per cent year on year. Larger units of 100 square metres or above increased 1 per cent month on month and 10 per cent year on year.

zh.headline: 6月私人住宅售價指數按月升0.3% 上半年累升近8%
zh.dek: 差餉物業估價署公布6月私人住宅售價指數報323.2，按年升12.7%，上半年累計升近7.9%。
body: 差餉物業估價署表示，本港6月私人住宅售價指數報323.2，較5月上升約0.3%，按年則升12.7%。
今年上半年樓價累計上升近7.9%。按月升幅較年內較早月份放緩。
中小型單位（100平方米以下）按月亦升約0.3%，按年升12.9%；100平方米或以上較大型單位按月升1%，按年升10%。
